name: Mandel Nallo
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: Tristar-based Bellator veteran ('Rat Garbage', 14-4, 1 NC) who earned a contract on the 2025 Contender Series at 36. An all-or-nothing first-round finisher: every one of his 14 wins is a stoppage, 12 of them in round one, but he was dropped and stopped by Jai Herbert in a wild 2:05 UFC debut in April.

how_they_fight.Striking: Loose, aggressive kickboxer: stiff jab, calf kicks, front and question-mark kicks to the head, hard right hand and overhand (UFC.com, Cageside Press). Dropped Samuel Silva with a right as Silva closed distance, and had Herbert down early in their fight (Cageside reports two knockdowns; our verified data credits him with one). Has a flying-knee KO of Carrington Banks in Bellator.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Underused but dangerous: four submission wins, all R1 or R2, and he used a leg lock to scramble up after Herbert dropped him. Finished Silva with ground-and-pound.
how_they_fight.Defense: The weak point. Comes in with his hands low and has been stopped in all four losses: KO R3 (Killys Mota 2019), KO R2 (Nick Browne 2022), submission R3 (Adam Piccolotti 2023), KO R1 (Herbert 2026). Rotowire notes he stepped in low-handed and ate the counter that ended the Herbert fight.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Extreme fast starter: 12 of 14 wins in R1, two in R2, none later, and no decision in 19 pro fights (wins or losses). When the fight survives his opening burst, his results turn: three of four losses came in R2-R3. At 37 the late-round picture is a real question mark.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Wants a fight, not a points race; recklessness after hurting someone cost him against Herbert, who took advantage when he overextended.

patterns: Explodes in round 1: 12 of 14 wins in R1, 2 in R2, none in R3
Never been to a decision; every fight ends inside the distance
Leads with kicks and the jab, then commits to the right hand
Stopped in all four losses, three of them in R2 or R3
concerns: Chin and defensive responsibility when he presses for the finish
Late-round cardio is unproven; at 37 with almost no deep fights
Weight class unclear: UFC.com lists lightweight, AgentMMA reported featherweight
keys_to_beat: Survive the first five minutes; he has never won after round 2
Counter his forward rushes with the right hand; he enters low-handed
Make it a grind and push him into round 3

news.text: Booked against Nate Landwehr in Edmonton on the main card. UFC.com lists it at lightweight; AgentMMA's announcement called it featherweight.
Lost his UFC debut to Jai Herbert by R1 TKO at 2:05 after dropping Herbert early; weighed 155.5 for that lightweight bout.
Media day: said his lesson from the Herbert loss is that 'my eagerness to finish' can get him in trouble, and he plans a more patient approach against Landwehr.
Official weigh-in: 155.5 lb for the lightweight bout; no misses reported on the card.
